payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the interfaces currently implemented for Macaw, including their functionalities and types.

claims.text: Macaw currently has three main interfaces: File IO, Standard IO, and Telegram.
The Standard IO is an interactive command line interface for development purposes, while the Telegram interface allows multi-modal interactions with real users.
The Telegram bot supports various devices and operating systems, enabling interactions through text, speech, click, and image.
